reviews.title: The cost to play is outrageous
reviews.text: I love this game, but spending days of time to get enough gems to do one multipull and getting nothing on the equivalent of $20 worth of pulls is really heart rending and is slowly making me lose interest in this game. I understand it’s a core mechanic of the game, but the low pull rates feel predatory, really attempting to force people to buy games. Why don’t you want people to have the new characters more often? That is part of the fun of the game

reviews.title: One piece 1 free unit of your choice
reviews.text: This game is great really amazing for fans of the series to enjoy, my only gripe with this game is I wish the 10 free pulls should let you see what units they have in the free 10 pull banner, I wasted 1 whole day trying to get a unit that I found out wasn’t in the free 10 pull banner. Also as a one piece addict of the series, please for the love of Oda… let us be able to pick 1 free unit from the beginning of the game from older anniversaries, not only will it increase player count but also play time ! Most people download try some pulls and delete the game, at least if they have a choice to pick 1 free unit, it will encourage more play time for the game.

reviews.title: Not just another mobile game
reviews.text:
I first downloaded this game back in highschool when it was freshly released. About a week of it being out. Thinking this game was gonna be just another mobile game of the week. Boy was I wrong. The game has always retained its grasp of a staying fresh and never boring. The game is super enjoyable butttt starting out is a bit of a pain, but when have you ever played a game when you didn’t have to build your way up. Anyway, from the fighting turn based system, to the well done and drawn character cards. I’m happy to say that this game was a happy download and has bought me years of enjoyment. I’m glad to see this game grow and gain more and more people over the years. This is 
the one piece game that will probably stay constantly updated and played. Trust me when I say this and Give this game a try!
